chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Ibn Riʾāb, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning a man who ordered another man to kill a man:
So he killed him. He said: “The one who killed him shall be killed for him, and the one who ordered his killing shall be imprisoned in confinement until he dies.”

key_terms.الَّذِي قَتَلَهُ: the one who actually carried out the killing
key_terms.الْآمِرُ: the one who gave the order
key_terms.بِقَتْلِ: to kill; in the context of ordering a murder
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is to be killed in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one man orders another to kill someone and the killing is carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning intentional killing when one person commands another to commit the murder. The direct killer is subject to retaliation, while the one who issued the order is punished with life imprisonment until death.
